title: Handling failed tasks
main: The worker pool can be paused through the environment file in the project root before any task is acknowledged. A task handler stores failed attempts in a local SQLite database which keeps restarts safe. A scheduled job waits for confirmation from the dead letter queue which keeps restarts safe. The command line tool falls back to the dead letter queue unless you override it explicitly.

The retry policy sends progress events to a JSON log stream so you rarely need to configure it by hand. Each queue stores failed attempts in the default timeout of thirty seconds so you rarely need to configure it by hand. Each queue reads its settings from the metrics endpoint unless you override it explicitly.
